# GitHub milestone template

Used to create one GitHub milestone per planned version. The milestone's issues together deliver that version.

**Title:** `vX.Y - <name>`, e.g. `v0.2 - Monorepo setup` or `v2 - Pick-up and drop-off`.

**Description:**

```md
# Description

[maximum 2 sentences describing what the version delivers]

# Targets

## [area]

- **[target]**: done when [verifiable outcome]
```

Add one `## [area]` section for every area of work the version covers (e.g. `Development setup`, `Contacts`), listing only the targets that belong to this version.
